Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 

ARBORS WITH MORSE TAPER SHANKS 

FOR SHELL TOOLS 

( First Revision ) 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and requirements for arbors with morse taper shanks and 
taper, fitment-taper 1 : 30 ( included ), with tenon drive for shell tools.

IS : 5936 - 1981 

3. Maternal — Carbon steel with tensile strength not less than 600 MPa*. 

4. Hasrdnsss — Taper arbor, taper shank and driving tenons shall be case-hardened to 680 .W, 
Min. 

5. General Requirements 

5=1 Dimensions of tenons shall be according to IS : 5568-1978 * Dimensions for tenons and cross- 
slots with taper bore 1 : 30 {first revision ) \ 

5.2 Morse taper shanks shall be according to IS : 1715-1973 ' Dimensions for self holding tapers 
{first revision) \ 

5.3 The permissible deviations or dimensions with unspecified tolerances shall be of grade medium 
according to IS : 2102-1969 ' Allowable deviations for dimensions with specified tolerances (first 
revision ) '. 

6. Designation — An arbor with nominal diameter c/i = 22 mm and conforming to this standard 
shall be designated as: 

Arbor 22 IS : 5936 

7. Marking — Shall be marked with arbor diameter dj and manufacturer's name or trade-mark. 
7.1 ISI Certification MarA/V7gf~ Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Protective Coating and Packing 

8.1 Each arbor shall be covered with anti-rust material and wrapped in water-proof paper. 

8.2 Each arbor or a number of arbors shall be packed In a carton bearing the size, number of 
arbors and manufacturer's name or trade-mark. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

i This standard was first published in 1970, This revision has been necessitated, so as to 

rbring^it jn line with the work done at ISO level. In the present revision the requirements of 10 mm 
arbd> have b^en deleted SiS same is not much used in the industry. 

o^ In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from: 

[SO 2402-1972 ' Shell reamers with taper bore (taper bore 1 : 30 included) with slot drive 
and arbors for shell reamers '. International Organization for Standardization, 

DIN 217-1972 Aufsteckhalter mit Morsekegl fur Aufsteck-Reibahien und Aufsteck-Aufbohrer 
( Arbors with morse taper for shell reamers and shell drills ). Deutsches Institut fiir Normung.
